[[Mallyx's Endurance]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] obtained from the [[Citadel Chest]], which spawns after [[Mallyx the Unyielding]] is defeated in [[The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx]].

==Stats==
:[[Earth damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Energy Storage]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (10% chance)
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as [[List_of_elementalist_crafted_weapons#Wands_3|crafted wands]] in the Energy Storage attribute inflict Chaos damage, not Earth damage.

Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create a chaos damage version for this item with:
*One of the following [[Energy Storage]] [[wand]]s:
**[[Asuran Scepter]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Rod]] from collector [[Zaishen Elemental Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Scepter]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Fan of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Scepter]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Scepter]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Voltaic Wand]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Charr Scepter]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Scepter]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Scepter]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Scepter]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Wand Wrapping]] [[of Quickening]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Hale and Hearty]]" inscription

==Unique counterparts==
* [[Imperial Dragon Wand]], [[The People's Will]] and [[Xun Rao's Justice]] have stats nearly identical to this item; however, they inflict [[Fire damage]] and require [[Divine Favor]], [[Soul Reaping]], [[Fast Casting]], [[Energy Storage]], or [[Spawning Power]].
* [[Plague-Soaked Stave]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Dark damage]] and requires Divine Favor, Soul Reaping, Fast Casting, Energy Storage, or Spawning Power.
